    How to use orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0 with llama.cpp:

    Install (macOS, Linux)
    curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh # Start a local OpenAI-compatible server with a web UI: llama serve -hf orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0:Q8_0 # Run inference directly in the terminal: llama cli -hf orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0:Q8_0
    Install from WinGet (Windows)
    winget install llama.cpp # Start a local OpenAI-compatible server with a web UI: llama serve -hf orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0:Q8_0 # Run inference directly in the terminal: llama cli -hf orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0:Q8_0
    Use pre-built binary
    # Download pre-built binary from: # https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/releases # Start a local OpenAI-compatible server with a web UI: ./llama-server -hf orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0:Q8_0 # Run inference directly in the terminal: ./llama-cli -hf orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0:Q8_0
    Build from source code
    git clone https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp.git cd llama.cpp cmake -B build cmake --build build -j --target llama-server llama-cli # Start a local OpenAI-compatible server with a web UI: ./build/bin/llama-server -hf orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0:Q8_0 # Run inference directly in the terminal: ./build/bin/llama-cli -hf orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0:Q8_0

    docker model run hf.co/orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0:Q8_0

OrcaRouter AI Gateway · X · Discord · GitHub · All Models

A security engineer's model. Runs locally.

OrcaCyber Nano 1.0 is a 27B vision-language reasoning model built for defensive security work — and packed as GGUF so it runs on your own hardware, offline, where the binaries and logs you are analyzing never leave the machine.

Built for: reverse engineering · vulnerability analysis · secure code review · triage · incident response

Why run it locally

Security work is exactly the kind of work you do not want to send to a cloud endpoint: proprietary binaries, customer logs, internal source, unreleased vulnerabilities. GGUF + llama.cpp means the model runs on the same box as your tools, air-gapped if you need it.

  • Reverse engineering & decompilation — paste disassembly or decompiler output; recover what a stripped function does, name variables, explain control flow.
  • Vulnerability analysis — reason about exploitability, find the unsafe path, propose a patch.
  • Secure code review — audit diffs and files for injection, memory-safety and logic bugs.
  • Triage — read logs, alerts and packet captures; separate signal from noise.
  • Vision — feed screenshots, Ghidra/IDA captures, network diagrams.

It identifies as OrcaCyber Nano 1.0 AI Defense Model and keeps full general-purpose reasoning, so it is also a strong local coding and reasoning assistant.

Loads in stock llama.cpp — no custom kernels.

Serving (llama.cpp) 

hf download orcarouter/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0 --local-dir ./ocn-gguf

# 16 GB card: Mix-13G + the built-in MTP drafter, 32k context
llama-server -m ocn-gguf/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0-AI-Defense-Mix-13G.gguf \
  --spec-type draft-mtp -np 1 -ngl 99 -c 32768

# 24 GB+ card: Mix-15.7G + DFlash2 drafter + vision
llama-server -m ocn-gguf/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0-AI-Defense-Mix-15.7G.gguf \
  --mmproj ocn-gguf/mmproj-OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0-AI-Defense-F16.gguf \
  -md ocn-gguf/OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0-AI-Defense-DFlash2-Q8_0.gguf --spec-type draft-dflash \
  --spec-draft-n-max 7 -ngl 99 -ngld 99 -c 32768

The MTP head is built into both main files; 

--spec-type draft-mtp
turns it on with no extra file. Pass the 
mmproj
file for image input. 
llama-server
defaults to 4 slots; pass 
-np 1
on small cards.

Recommended sampling 

temperature = 1.0
top_p       = 0.95
top_k       = 20

OrcaCyber​​ Nano 1.0 是一个为防御安全工作而构建的 27B 视觉语言推理模型，并打包为 GGUF，因此它可以在您自己的硬件上离线运行，您正在分析的二进制文件和日志永远不会离开机器。

专为：逆向工程·漏洞分析·安全代码审查·分类·事件响应

为什么要在本地运行

安全工作正是您不想发送到云端点的工作：专有二进制文件、客户日志、内部源代码、未发布的漏洞。 GGUF + llama.cpp 意味着模型与您的工具在同一个盒子上运行，如果您需要的话，可以进行气隙。

  • 逆向工程和反编译——粘贴反汇编或反编译器输出；恢复剥离函数的功能、命名变量、解释控制流。
  • 漏洞分析——对可利用性进行推理，找到不安全路径，提出补丁。
  • 安全代码审查——审核注入、内存安全和逻辑错误的差异和文件。
  • 分类——读取日志、警报和数据包捕获；将信号与噪声分开。
  • 愿景——提要屏幕截图、Ghidra/IDA 捕获、网络图。

它标识为OrcaCyber​​ Nano 1.0 AI防御模型，保留了完整的通用推理能力，因此也是强大的本地编码和推理助手。
